source: GeoNames' towns of 1,000 people or more (cities1000.txt, https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/), cut down by tools/towns.ts to the towns of the 7,954 places of the live list, the food and drink places the app loads, read from the places relay.
licence: Town names from GeoNames (geonames.org), CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
regenerate: Read the live list from the places relay, one event to a line: nak req -k 39999 -a <house key> -t z=<list coordinate> -l 10000 wss://dcosl.brainstorm.world > places-live.jsonl (the key and the coordinate are config.houseHex and config.headerCoordinate in src/config.ts). Download cities1000.zip from GeoNames and unzip it. Then: node tools/towns.ts cities1000.txt places-live.jsonl --date <download day>. Do not edit this file by hand.
